summaries.2025-12-01: December opened on schedule: rent, Hydro, and the internet bill all cleared on the 1st, with two coffees carrying the workday.
summaries.2025-12-02: Flights to Vancouver booked — Air Canada for the holidays — alongside a Metro run, a Solis class, and the PRESTO auto-reload.
summaries.2025-12-04: A grocery top-up at Metro, dinner at Fox and John's on Liberty Village, and metered parking downtown.
summaries.2025-12-06: Saturday circuit: the main Loblaws shop on Queen West and an LCBO stop ahead of a hosting weekend.
summaries.2025-12-07: Weekend brunch at Queen Mother and a film at the Lightbox.
summaries.2025-12-08: Only the New York Times Digital autopay went through — no card left the wallet.
summaries.2025-12-09: Lunch at Banh Mi Boys and coffee at Arvo.
summaries.2025-12-10: One coffee at Arvo, nothing else.
summaries.2025-12-11: Groceries at FreshCo, a class at Solis, and the usual Sam James morning.
summaries.2025-12-12: A late Uber home, the PRESTO auto-reload on its ten-day rhythm, and coffee at Balzac's.
summaries.2025-12-13: Gift mode. Indigo at the Eaton Centre, a La Palma dinner on Dundas West, and a late Uber home; the second big Loblaws run doubled as party prep.
summaries.2025-12-14: An evening at Libretto, a Type Books stop, and the usual Tim Hortons morning.
summaries.2025-12-15: A Banh Mi Boys lunch and coffee at Arvo.
summaries.2025-12-16: Winners at the Stockyards for the family gift round — one receipt, most of the list.
summaries.2025-12-17: One stop, one box: the Apple Store gift destined for the Vancouver suitcase.
summaries.2025-12-18: Last full working day before the trip — Best Buy for the second gift, a Metro top-up, lunch at Sud Forno, and a Solis class squeezed in.
summaries.2025-12-19: Pre-flight Friday: Balzac's with the laptop in the morning, then LCBO on Queens Quay for host gifts.
summaries.2025-12-20: Early ride to Pearson. Toronto goes quiet for a week.
summaries.2025-12-24: Christmas Eve in Vancouver — one Uber across town; everything else stayed off Mira's cards.
summaries.2025-12-27: The ride back from Pearson closed out the week away.
summaries.2025-12-28: Back home: Kensington produce, a Queen Mother brunch, a household restock, and a deliberately small $100 sweep after a flight-heavy month.
summaries.2025-12-29: Catch-up dinner at Cibo Wine Bar with the King West crowd, plus a New Year's wine run at the Bay & King LCBO.
summaries.2025-12-30: Oysters at Pure Spirits for the year-end dinner — the Distillery District at its most festive.
summaries.2025-12-31: New Year's Eve prep: one more Loblaws basket and a Sud Forno lunch before the kitchen took over.
